name: Report
description: Admin analytics and reports: nightly and hourly aggregates of sales, fulfilment, RTO, returns and payment mix (daily_sales_stat, daily_product_stat), the KPI service with date-range comparison and a live today, leaderboards of sellers, products, categories, states and pincodes, report pages with charts and table views, CSV/Excel exports (streamed or queued), the backend dashboard widget and the supplier analytics page.
